native.requirement_coverage: All 34 requirements from the initial audit; all 11 CSIR domains; source-profile requirements listed separately.

requirements.future_closure: Preserve int32/int64 overflow, shifts, promotions, division edge cases and evaluation order or prove range bounds.
requirements.rule: Only source-width range-proved scalar addition; reject all unsupported operators and overflow-capable paths. Prove bounds over the complete declared input/state scope; source-valid out-of-scope behavior must trigger conversion refusal or explicit scope restriction, never silent runtime truncation.

requirements.future_closure: Verify framework event ordering, EDT, bindings, custom controls and proportional layout.
requirements.rule: Only finite admitted headless scenes and explicit D1 event bindings. Source must already restrict numeric input to the same canonical decimal/source-width domain, or carry an explicit narrowed execution scope; GSSH rejects +1, 01 and -0 that Java may accept. Reject framework event/lifecycle behavior and unsupported parsing without proof.

requirements.future_closure: Verify recovery, fidelity, finite reachability and target admission; handle unbounded/raster content correctly.
requirements.rule: Graphics source integration observed initially is absent from the frozen resolver baseline; reject Java graphical behavior until fidelity, bounded reachability and target admission are independently established.

source.compiler_options: Record release/source/target/encoding values when literal; mismatches or computed values require diagnostics.
source.generated_sources: Only explicitly supplied source; processors/plugins remain disabled.
grammar_coverage_required: all non-preview Java SE 17 source forms
source.module_policy: Inventory packages/modules and supplied classpath/module-path; unresolved symbols block completeness, never imply absent code.
source.parse_completeness: Phase1 evidence required; source eligibility is not a claim of parsing, attribution or native execution support.
source.source_roots: Explicit supplied roots; never execute build configuration to infer roots.
source.symbol_policy: Only explicitly supplied versioned Java17 symbol inventories; absent JDK/API symbols stay unresolved.
source.unicode_escapes: Translate per Java lexical rules before tokenization; map translated offsets to exact original UTF-8 byte ranges.
